verdict.rationale: MailerLite's own docs show event-driven actions inside the product: emails triggered on booking, abandoned-cart automations triggered by cart events, and automations manageable from its CLI. There is no detailed documentation of a general rule builder with configurable triggers, conditions and actions, so how far users can define their own rules is unproven. Missing for 10: documented automation workflow builder (trigger types, conditions, action steps), breadth of supported event triggers, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: manage subscribers, campaigns, automations, and more from your terminal
